issues.title: Refine organizer-managed tournament entries and withdrawals
issues.body:
## Problem

Research for #213 in `openspec/changes/issue-213-registration-research/findings.md` distinguishes entry requests, accepted rosters, doubles membership and authenticated identities. Existing configuration IDs and policy enums do not provide a confirmed registration workflow.

## Scope and acceptance criteria

- Run a separate full feature lifecycle. Validate a concrete organizer scenario before implementation.
- Decide the authorized actor, identity namespace/provenance, singles/doubles membership, minimal entry states, correction and withdrawal behavior, and intake closure. Separate verified rules from product choices.
- Specify successful and rejected operations, duplicate/capacity handling, concurrent edits and privacy/audit behavior; distinguish an entry from a draw roster and public announcement.
- Assess current REST/JWT compatibility, context ownership and any migration before selecting a design. Do not assume a Player Management service, external integration, frontend stack, public self-registration, delegation or invitation-token workflow.

## Validation

Define applicable tests and persona UAT in the approved feature. Backend changes require the repository Maven verify flow; documentation requires `npm run format:check`. Any shared IAM, migration, dependency, module or public-contract change requires explicit lifecycle assessment.

Refs #213.
